CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid packaging of Lian Li Linux, the open-source replacement for L-Connect 3 by sgtaziz, with a web dashboard and Unraid stats for Lian Li LCD screens.
For help with this package, open an issue at https://github.com/teh1percent/lian-li-linux-unraid/issues
Not affiliated with Lian Li Industrial Co., Ltd.
